## Methods

Each of the 24 patients is drawn as one horizontal bar whose length is the value of months, sorted from the longest course at the top. An arrow marks a course that was ongoing at the data cut-off. Symbols mark response_month (12 patient(s)), progression_month (13 patient(s)). control: 12 patient(s), median duration 2.4, 0 ongoing; treated: 12 patient(s), median duration 14.4, 5 ongoing. The figure is descriptive, so no statistical test is applied. Drawn in R 4.4.1 with ggplot2 3.5.1.
